Having accumulated experience, Narita Top 
Road has grown truly capable. Yet, she 
remains somewhat clumsy—still pushing 
herself too hard, or freezing up 
completely when told not to overexert 
herself...

One day, I went to watch a graded race 
that Admire Vega was running in. —It was a 
polished, utterly dominant performance.

Witnessing her archrival's magnificent 
run, Narita Top Road's expression 
shifted... because she had finally 
understood.

Reckless determination alone wouldn't let 
her catch up, nor would it lead her to the 
summit—which was all the more reason to 
keep piling on the steady, diligent 
effort.

Her impatience gone and having found the 
right way to put in the effort, Narita Top 
Road challenges the shining star she 
admires, Admire Vega, at the Yayoi Sho!
